verses.text: Keep digging in your heels every time someone corrects you, and ruin will hit without warning. There'll be no fixing it.
When people who do right thrive, everyone celebrates. When the wicked rule, people groan.
Anyone who loves wisdom brings their father joy. Anyone who keeps company with prostitutes blows through their wealth.
A king who rules with justice keeps the land steady. A king who takes bribes tears it down.
Flattering your neighbor is like spreading a net under their feet.
Evil people are trapped by their own sin. People who do right can sing for joy.
People who do right care about justice for the poor. The wicked don't care to understand it.
Mockers get a whole city worked up. Wise people calm its anger.
When a wise person takes a fool to court, the fool rages or mocks. Either way, there's no peace.
People out for blood hate anyone with integrity. They seek the lives of those who live uprightly.
A fool lets all their anger out. A wise person keeps it under control.
If a ruler listens to lies, all their officials turn wicked.
Poor people and their oppressors have this in common: the LORD gives both of them sight.
A king who judges the poor fairly will have a throne that stands forever.
The rod of correction teaches wisdom. A child left to do whatever they want brings shame to their mother.
When the wicked multiply, sin multiplies. People who do right will see them fall.
Correct your son and he'll bring you peace. He'll bring joy to your soul.
Without revelation, people throw off restraint. Blessed is anyone who keeps the law.
Words alone won't correct a servant. They may understand and still refuse to respond.
See someone who speaks before they think? There's more hope for a fool than for them.
Pamper a servant from childhood and in the end they'll become like a son.
An angry person starts fights. Someone full of rage commits sin after sin.
Pride brings people low. A humble spirit earns honor.
Anyone who partners with a thief acts against their own life. They hear the oath but don't dare testify.
Fear of other people is a trap. Trust the LORD and you'll be kept safe.
Many people want a ruler's favor, but justice comes from the LORD.
Dishonest people detest those who do right. People who walk uprightly detest the wicked.
